ModMetaData.name: Stickyfoam Continued (1.6 beta)
ModMetaData.author: katana (original); BiggestFren (continuation)
ModMetaData.description: Beta continuation of katana's Stickyfoam for RimWorld 1.6. Adds mobility-restricting foam through mortar rounds and IED traps. Replaces the original Stickyfoam: disable the original before enabling this continuation. Uninstall from ongoing saves is unsupported. Genuine 1.5 migration and arbitrary third-party mod compatibility are unverified; north-facing dusters can hide coating. Original author: katana; original MIT license retained.
